name: yogurt-icons
description: Search 7,000+ free Yogurt Icon icons and retrieve SVG or React JSX when the user needs icons for an interface or project.
---

Use the Yogurt Icon MCP tools to search before retrieving an icon. `search_icons` accepts English or Chinese keywords. Use `list_categories` when a category would help narrow the result.

Call `get_icon` with the name returned by search. Match the requested outline or solid style, size, stroke width and SVG or JSX format. For a set of icons, keep their visual style and dimensions consistent. Do not invent an icon name or substitute a hand-drawn shape for an existing library result.

Yogurt Icon tools are public and free. Call them without registering, signing in, providing tokens or opening an OAuth flow. Website favorites alone require an account; icon retrieval does not.

If tools are not visible, use the host's tool discovery when available. If the client still requests Yogurt login, explain that older plugin versions declared OAuth and the installed plugin or MCP configuration needs refreshing. Do not start an authorization flow or ask for credentials. Change the installation only if the user requests it. Host installation trust and tool approval prompts are controlled by the host.

Return the requested icon markup or add it to the user's project as requested. Preserve copyright and license comments included in SVG or JSX results. The tools only read the existing catalog; they cannot import external URLs, generate new artwork, or read or modify accounts and favorites. Do not change the client's installation or unrelated project settings while retrieving icons.

# Yogurt Icon client plugins

**7,000+ free icons for your coding assistant.** Find icons in the [Yogurt Icon](https://icon.ggeric.top) library and get SVG or React JSX for your interface. Icon search and retrieval are free, with no Yogurt login, API key, or sign-up required.

Once enabled, your agent can select Yogurt Icon for relevant icon requests. You can also name it explicitly: "Use Yogurt Icon to find a 24px settings SVG." Automatic tool selection and any approval prompt are controlled by your coding assistant.

| Client | Files | Distribution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Claude Code | [claude](claude/) | Publisher-hosted marketplace at this repository |
| Cursor | [cursor](cursor/) | Import from Disk or local plugin folder; marketplace submission is pending review |
| OpenCode | [opencode](opencode/) | [yogurt-icon-opencode on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/yogurt-icon-opencode) |
| VS Code | [vscode](vscode/) | [Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=yogurt-icon.yogurt-icon) or VSIX |

Gemini CLI has its own [distribution repository](https://github.com/prosody007/yogurt-icon-gemini).

Download standalone Claude and Cursor ZIPs, the VS Code VSIX, and the OpenCode npm archive from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/prosody007/yogurt-icon-plugins/releases). These downloads are publisher distributions; vendor directory listings have separate review processes.

## Claude Code

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add prosody007/yogurt-icon-plugins
claude plugin install yogurt-icon@yogurt-icon-native
```

## OpenCode

Add the published package to the `plugin` array in your OpenCode configuration:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["yogurt-icon-opencode@1.3.4"]
}
```

## Service usage

The adapters connect to `https://icon.ggeric.top/api/mcp?channel=plugin`. The service records aggregate tool usage; icon retrieval counts include the icon, style, and format. Anonymous requests are not a count of unique users. See the [privacy policy](https://icon.ggeric.top/privacy/) for data handling. The adapters do not bundle the icon catalog for offline use.

## Scope and licensing

The MIT license applies to client adapter software, manifests, skill instructions and documentation. See [RIGHTS.md](RIGHTS.md) for exclusions. The icon catalog, returned artwork, brand logo and website server are not relicensed under MIT. Preserve notices in retrieved artwork and follow the [icon usage terms](https://icon.ggeric.top/terms/).

These files define a remote connection and usage instructions. They do not contain the icon database, account data, website server, API credentials or model subscriptions. Publishing this repository does not imply approval or listing by a client vendor.

# Yogurt Icon for Claude Code

**7,000+ free icons, right in Claude Code.** Find an icon and get ready-to-use SVG or React JSX for your interface. No Yogurt account, API key, or sign-up is needed to search or retrieve icons.

Once enabled, Claude can choose Yogurt Icon for icon requests. You can also specify it: "Use Yogurt Icon to find an outline settings icon and return its 24px SVG." Automatic tool selection and approval prompts are controlled by Claude Code.

## Install

Install from the public marketplace repository:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add prosody007/yogurt-icon-plugins
claude plugin install yogurt-icon@yogurt-icon-native
```

Restart Claude Code, or run `/reload-plugins`, then inspect `/mcp`. This is publisher-hosted distribution; it does not imply an Anthropic directory listing.

Search the Yogurt Icon catalog by English or Chinese keyword, category, and outline or solid style. Retrieve an existing result as SVG or React JSX at a chosen size, with optional stroke width. The plugin uses three read-only tools: `list_categories`, `search_icons`, and `get_icon`.

Connects to `https://icon.ggeric.top/api/mcp?channel=plugin`. No Yogurt account, API key, or OAuth is required. The host controls normal installation trust and tool-use prompts. Website favorites require a separate website sign-in and are not exposed by the plugin. The tools do not import arbitrary URLs, create new artwork, edit the catalog, or access user accounts.

Search queries and retrieval requests are sent to Yogurt Icon. Search text is not stored as history; successful retrievals are counted anonymously by icon, style, format and channel as explained in the privacy policy. The plugin itself does not store user data. It does not send requests to a second service or run a local MCP server.

Keep copyright and license notices in returned icons. Client adapter code and instructions are MIT licensed; see LICENSE and RIGHTS.md for scope. Icon artwork remains covered by the service terms and its included notices.

# Yogurt Icon for OpenCode

**7,000+ free icons for OpenCode.** Find icons and get SVG or React JSX for your UI. No Yogurt account, API key, or sign-up is needed to search or retrieve icons.

Once enabled, OpenCode can choose Yogurt Icon for icon requests. You can also specify it: "Use Yogurt Icon to find an outline settings icon and return its 24px SVG." Automatic tool selection and approval prompts are controlled by OpenCode.

## Install

This plugin registers the public Yogurt Icon MCP server from OpenCode's configuration hook. It preserves an existing `yogurt-icon` MCP definition, including a disabled definition or a custom endpoint.

## Install from this repository

Copy `index.js` to `~/.config/opencode/plugins/yogurt-icon.js`, or to your project's `.opencode/plugins/yogurt-icon.js`, then restart OpenCode. This local method is available independently of npm publication. Do not install a second copy if the existing local plugin already loads.

## Install from npm

Add the [yogurt-icon-opencode](https://www.npmjs.com/package/yogurt-icon-opencode) package to the `plugin` array in your OpenCode configuration, preserving other entries:

```json
{ "plugin": ["yogurt-icon-opencode@1.3.4"] }
```

Restart OpenCode, then run `opencode mcp list` to check the connection. Use either the npm package or the local JavaScript file, so the same plugin is not loaded twice.

# Yogurt Icon — 7,000+ Free Icons

**Find the right icon without leaving VS Code.** Ask GitHub Copilot for an icon and get SVG or React JSX from a library of **7,000+ icons**, ready to use in your interface.

**Free icon search and retrieval. No Yogurt account, API key, or sign-up required.**

- **7,000+ icons** for navigation, settings, dashboards, commerce, communication, and more.
- **SVG and React JSX** you can use directly in your project.
- **Outline and solid styles**, with adjustable size and stroke width for stroke icons.
- **Works inside Copilot chat**: Copilot can choose it for icon requests, or you can name Yogurt Icon explicitly.

[Browse the icon library](https://icon.ggeric.top) · [Get help](https://icon.ggeric.top/support/)

## Try it in Copilot

> Find an outline settings icon in Yogurt Icon and return its 24px SVG.

> 用 Yogurt Icon 找一个搜索图标，返回 24px 的 React JSX。

> Find matching home, search, and settings icons in Yogurt Icon. Use the same outline style and 24px size.

Once the tools are enabled, Copilot can select Yogurt Icon for an icon request. You can also ask explicitly: "Use Yogurt Icon to find a 24px settings SVG." Copilot controls automatic tool selection and any approval prompt. It searches the catalog and retrieves the actual icon code, including its original geometry and any license notices.

## Get started

1. Install **Yogurt Icon** from the VS Code Marketplace.
2. Open Copilot chat in agent mode. In **Configure Tools**, enable **Yogurt Icon**.
3. Send one of the prompts above. Approve the host's tool prompt if shown.

Requires VS Code 1.102 or newer and access to GitHub Copilot. Yogurt Icon is free; Copilot account requirements and usage limits are managed separately by GitHub.

If the tools are missing, reload VS Code and use **MCP: List Servers** to find and start **Yogurt Icon**. For a downloaded VSIX, use **Extensions: Install from VSIX**. You can also open the library with **Yogurt Icon: Open Icon Library**.

## Privacy and permissions

The extension connects to the hosted Yogurt Icon service at `https://icon.ggeric.top/api/mcp?channel=plugin` using three read-only tools: `list_categories`, `search_icons`, and `get_icon`. Search and retrieval requests are sent to Yogurt Icon. Search text is not stored as history; successful retrievals are counted anonymously by icon, style, format, and channel. See the [privacy policy](https://icon.ggeric.top/privacy/) for details.

The plugin does not access accounts or favorites. Only saving favorites on the website requires a Yogurt account. Installation trust and tool approval prompts are controlled by VS Code.

## Icon usage and support

Keep copyright and license notices included in returned SVG or JSX, including Lucide/Feather notices. Icon artwork is covered by the [icon usage terms](https://icon.ggeric.top/terms/). The MIT license covers the client adapter and documentation; see [RIGHTS.md](https://github.com/prosody007/yogurt-icon-plugins/blob/main/vscode/RIGHTS.md) for its scope.
